hook.name: ZoraV4CoinHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Zora Coins that sets a dynamic launch fee decaying linearly from 99% to 1% over a short window after coin creation. On every swap, it collects accrued LP fees, mints LP rewards, swaps fees to a backing currency via multi-hop paths, distributes rewards to recipients, and fills Zora limit orders based on tick movement.
